question: What happens if tuition is unpaid after deadline?

doc.title: Billing Policy
doc.text: # Billing Policy Students must pay tuition by the posted deadline. Accounts with unpaid balances may receive a late fee and registration hold.

question: What are dorm pet rules for exotic animals?

doc.title: Library Noise Policy
doc.text: # Library Noise Policy Quiet floors require silent study. Phone calls are allowed only in lobby zones.
